content:
jin: Quick heads-up from the canary: observed weirdness with stop sequences + max_tokens=0 returning no logprobs.

jin: Repro run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rw-kv-7b",
    "prompt":"Translate: Hello",
    "max_tokens":0,
    "temperature":0.0,
    "top_p":1.0,
    "stop":["\n"] ,
    "logprobs":5
  }'
```

jin: Expected: zero new tokens but still return logprobs/context tokens and choice text (empty string). Seen: choices[0].logprobs is null and choices[0].text missing in some cases.

alex: ack. Is this only with stop that equals trailing token boundary? any example where stop triggers immediately and we still lose fields?

jin: Mostly when prompt ends with a char that matches stop and sampler short-circuits. Also duplicates when temperature=0 + top_p < 1 (edge in sampler early-exit path).

sam: Likely because the early-exit path returns a different response struct and skips the logprobs assembly step. I saw similar in an old patch (sam/patch-quant-early-exit).

maria: This will break downstream clients that assume choices[*].text exists and that logprobs present when requested. Product impact: analytics/evals rely on token logprobs for scoring.

jin: Proposed quick fix: unify early-exit response builder to populate empty text and compute logprobs from prefix tokens (even if no new tokens). Minimal perf hit but keeps contract.

sam: ok. PR ready? link?

jin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423

jin: Diff summary: move logprob assembly out of generation loop into response layer; ensure choices[].text = "" when no new tokens; add unit test: stop-at-boundary + max_tokens=0 -> logprobs non-null.

qa-bot: smoke tests queued: canary-01, canary-02. Failing test: canary-02 shows null logprobs for model rw-kv-7b on cuda-rtx-2.

sam: I can reproduce locally with the exact CANARY env (CUDA_RT=2). Investigating sampler.c fast path.

alex: question — are we sure this is strictly a server-side response shape issue and not SDK hiding fields? which SDK versions reproduce?

jin: Confirmed both raw curl and python-sdk v0.9.1 show missing fields. SDK v0.9.1 doesn't coerce anything here.

maria: Timeline: we need a fix gated behind canary and a rollback plan. If not fixed in 24h, revert canary to previous model variant.

jen (oncall): FYI I'll watch rollout and canary alerts. If error rate > 0.5% for analytical endpoints, we roll back.

sam: digging: suspicious code in sampler/stop_handler.cpp — it returns early with code path id 0x7f that skips the ResponseAssembler call.

jin: Suggested patch: move ResponseAssembler::assemble_logprobs(prefix_state) into finally{} section of inference loop; it's idempotent.

sam: will put up hotfix branch sam/hf/logprobs-ensure by EOD. Requesting review from @jin and @alex.

alex: pinging infra: @deploy-bot please hold canary promotion until hotfix merges and passes canary smoke.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for canary-01 and canary-02. Awaiting PR merge + green tests.

maria: Also flagging backward-compat test in release checklist: add automated check that choices[].text present for max_tokens >=0 and logprobs requested.

sam: PR opened: #1427 (hotfix). Includes unit test and a small perf guard. Bench shows <0.2% extra latency at p95 for short prompts.

jin: lgtm on tests. @alex can you review response layering change? it's small.

alex: Reviewing now. quick question on top_p+temperature interplay — does moving assembly change sampling semantics? we must ensure we don't alter sampling, only response formatting.

sam: assembly only touches after-sampling bookkeeping. no effect on sampled token decisions.

alex: ok. approving.

deploy-bot: PR #1427 merged. Running canary smoke.

qa-bot: canary-01 green, canary-02 flaky on rw-kv-7b (GPU memory pressure), but logprob test passes when non-flaky.

maria: good. schedule merge to main and release train if no regressions in 6h.

jin: thanks all. follow-up items: (1) add regression test to evals repo; (2) audit other early-exit paths (sampling with stop tokens, length limit triggers). I'll open tickets.

jin: ticket #467: audit early-exit response shapes.

sam: +1. will help.

alex: closing loop: update SDK docs to note choices[].text present even when no tokens generated.

maria: tagging CS for heads-up: they might see client bug reports otherwise.

sam: done. PRs linked in thread.

jin: alright — monitoring for next 12h. thanks :thumbsup:
